name: processPatientDataRequest
shortDescription: Handles patient requests for data access, correction, or deletion, ensuring privacy compliance.
description:
Overview

Manages patient requests to access, correct, or delete their personal and medical data, updating ConsentRecord status and ensuring regulatory compliance.

Intended use

Called by the patient-facing UI when a patient submits a data request, or by an administrator processing such a request. Parameters include patientId, consentType, and the requested action.

Logic

  1. Retrieve the ConsentRecord associated with the params.patientId and params.consentType.
  2. Based on the requested action (e.g., 'data_access', 'data_correction', 'data_deletion'), perform necessary operations:
    • For access: Retrieve relevant Patient and MedicalRecord data.
    • For correction: Update specific fields in Patient or MedicalRecord as per the request.
    • For deletion: Soft-delete relevant Patient or MedicalRecord entries, or anonymize data.
  3. Update the ConsentRecord.status to reflect the processing of the request (e.g., 'pending', 'granted', 'revoked') using ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the data request and its resolution using ctx.audit.log for compliance purposes.
  5. Notify the patient of the request status via ctx.email.send_template.
  6. Return the updated ConsentRecord status.

Entities

  • ConsentRecord
  • Patient
  • MedicalRecord
